platforms.title: Platforms it works on
platforms.description: Viewers on these platforms can throw Jars, and wild critters are announced in their chats.

commandPlatforms.title: Where typing !catch throws a Jar
commandPlatforms.description: Untick a platform (such as Twitch or Kick) to throw only with the channel point rewards listed under Jars. !catch journal, top and info still work everywhere.

catchCommand.title: Chat command
catchCommand.description: Viewers type it to throw a Jar. Add honey or moon for a stronger Jar, journal for their Field Journal, top for this month's best Keepers, or info and a critter's name. Moderators add spawn, end, pause or resume. Do not include the ! prefix.

honeyWord.title: Word for a Honey Jar
honeyWord.description: Viewers type !catch honey. Change it to match your language.

critterSet.title: Which critters visit
critterSet.description: The 151 built-in Village Critters, your own list, or both.

customCritters.title: Your own critters
customCritters.description: Each row is one critter: its name, rarity, type, a picture link (https, a PNG, GIF or WebP) and its Field Journal entry.

jarCost.title: Jar cost
jarCost.description: Viewer Foundation points for one throw. 0 makes it free.

honeyCost.title: Honey Jar cost
honeyCost.description: A Honey Jar catches 1.5 times as often as a Jar.

moonCost.title: Moon Jar cost
moonCost.description: A Moon Jar catches 2.5 times as often as a Jar.

rewardThrows.title: Rewards and gifts that throw a Jar
rewardThrows.description: Use a Twitch or Kick channel point reward's ID (from Reward Timers or the Bridge's reward list) or its exact name, or a TikTok or YouTube gift name. The viewer already paid, so no Viewer Foundation points are taken.

toggleRewards.title: Turn the Twitch Jar rewards on only while a critter is on screen
toggleRewards.description: Needs the reward IDs above, the Reward Administration action in Streamer.bot, and Twitch rewards created in Streamer.bot (Twitch only lets the app that made a reward switch or refund it). A Twitch redemption that cannot throw (no critter, or already caught) is refunded. Kick rewards stay on: Streamer.bot has no Kick reward controls yet.

catchMode.title: Who catches it
catchMode.description: Everyone whose throw lands gets the critter, or only the first and then it leaves.

catchCap.title: Highest catch chance (%)
catchCap.description: No throw is ever surer than this.

visitMode.title: Where critters visit
visitMode.description: One platform at a time: each critter visits one platform whose chat is active, and platforms take turns. Every platform at once: one critter for everyone.

activeChatters.title: Chatters needed for a platform to get visits
activeChatters.description: Different people (not you, your accounts or bots) who chatted in the last few minutes.

onlyWhenChatting.title: Every platform at once: only visit while chat is active
onlyWhenChatting.description: Critters wait until someone has chatted in the last 10 minutes, so none wander in while you are offline.

commonWeight.title: How often Common critters visit
commonWeight.description: A share of all visits compared with the other rarities. 0 stops them.

uncommonWeight.title: How often Uncommon critters visit
uncommonWeight.description: A share of all visits compared with the other rarities. 0 stops them.

rareWeight.title: How often Rare critters visit
rareWeight.description: A share of all visits compared with the other rarities. 0 stops them.

guardianWeight.title: How often Guardian critters visit
guardianWeight.description: A share of all visits compared with the other rarities. 0 stops them.

glimmerOdds.title: Glimmer odds (1 in ...)
glimmerOdds.description: How rare a shiny Glimmer critter is. 0 turns Glimmers off.

commonFlee.title: Chance a Common critter runs off after a miss (%)

uncommonFlee.title: Chance a Uncommon critter runs off after a miss (%)

rareFlee.title: Chance a Rare critter runs off after a miss (%)

guardianFlee.title: Chance a Guardian critter runs off after a miss (%)

announceSpawns.title: Tell chat when a critter wanders in

spawnMessage.title: Critter wanders in
spawnMessage.default: A wild {critter} ({rarity}) wandered in! Type !{command} to throw a Jar.

glimmerSpawnMessage.title: Glimmer critter wanders in
glimmerSpawnMessage.default: A shimmering Glimmer {critter} ({rarity}) wandered in! Type !{command} to throw a Jar.

rewardSpawnMessage.title: A critter wandered in (reward-only platforms)
rewardSpawnMessage.description: Sent on platforms where !catch does not throw.
rewardSpawnMessage.default: A wild {critter} ({rarity}) wandered in! Redeem a Jar channel point reward to throw one.

caughtMessage.title: Caught
caughtMessage.default: {name} caught {critter} with a {jar}! Field Journal: {count} of {total}.

glimmerCaughtMessage.title: Glimmer caught
glimmerCaughtMessage.default: {name} caught a Glimmer {critter} with a {jar}! Field Journal: {count} of {total}.

announceEntry.title: Post the Field Journal entry after the first catch

entryMessage.title: Field Journal entry line
entryMessage.description: Sent once per visit, after the first catch. {number}, {critter}, {entry}, {type}, {rarity}.

announceMisses.title: Tell the thrower when a Jar misses

fledMessage.title: Ran off after a miss
fledMessage.default: {critter} broke out of {name}'s {jar} and scurried off into the woods.

announceLeaves.title: Tell chat when nobody caught it

leftMessage.title: Wandered off
leftMessage.default: {critter} wandered off. Watch for the next visitor!

rewardOnlyMessage.title: Typed !catch where only rewards throw
rewardOnlyMessage.default: {name}, here you throw a Jar by redeeming a Jar channel point reward.

noCritterMessage.title: No critter right now
noCritterMessage.default: No critter is wandering about right now. Watch the stream!

elsewhereMessage.title: Critter is on another platform
elsewhereMessage.default: {name}, {critter} is visiting {platformName} chat right now. The next one may wander in here!

alreadyMessage.title: Already caught this one
alreadyMessage.default: {name}, you already caught {critter} on this visit. Wait for the next critter!

cooldownMessage.title: Threw too soon
cooldownMessage.default: {name}, catch your breath. You can throw again in {seconds}s.

journalMessage.title: !catch journal
journalMessage.default: {name}'s Field Journal: {count} of {total} critters, {glimmers} Glimmer. {month} caught this month.

noCatchesMessage.title: No catches yet
noCatchesMessage.default: Nobody has caught a critter yet this month.

notCaughtMessage.title: !catch info for a critter they lack

mixedHintText.title: On-screen hint when some platforms use rewards

rarityNames.title: Rarity names
rarityNames.description: In this order: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Guardian.

jarNames.title: Jar names
jarNames.description: In this order: Jar, Honey Jar, Moon Jar.

timeZone.title: Time zone for monthly stats
timeZone.description: Monthly catches reset on the 1st in this time zone. Leave empty to use this PC's time zone. Example: America/Chicago.
